title: Navigation-Informed Embeddings: Dense-Retriever Adaptation from Agent Search Traces
abstract: arXiv:2608.15956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic retrieval workflows produce query, retrieval, and stopping traces as a byproduct of answering questions. We study how these traces can adapt a deployed dense retriever to changing workflow distributions without new relevance labels, synthetic queries, or LLM judgments. We introduce Navigation-Informed Embeddings (NIE), a family of trace-derived objectives. NIE-Stop turns the stopping document into a soft positive; NIE-Path additionally uses preceding path documents as hard comparisons and imposes ordinal constraints with geometric decay. A BGE encoder adapted from retained source trajectories improves support Recall@20 on an independent target benchmark from 72.2 to 78.0 overall. NIE-Stop reaches 76.9 overall and 52.3 on long paths; NIE-Path raises long-path performance to 55.4, compared with 46.7 for the unadapted encoder. translated_title: 导航信息嵌入：来自智能体搜索轨迹的密集检索器适配
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15956v1 公告类型：新 摘要：智能体检索工作流在回答问题的过程中会产生查询、检索和停止轨迹。我们研究了这些轨迹如何在不使用新的相关性标签、合成查询或大语言模型评判的情况下，适配已部署的密集检索器以适应不断变化的工作流分布。我们引入了导航信息嵌入（NIE），这是一族基于轨迹的优化目标。NIE-Stop将停止文档视为软正例；NIE-Path额外使用前面的路径文档作为硬对比，并通过几何衰减施加顺序约束。一个从保留的源轨迹适配的BGE编码器，在独立的目标基准上将支持Recall@20从72.2提升至78.0（总体）。NIE-Stop达到76.9（总体）和52.3（长路径）；NIE-Path将长路径性能提升至55.4，而未适配的编码器为46.7。在完整路径目标下，打乱顺序的对照组损失了3.2分。在不使用公开基准训练的情况下，实现了这些改进。
tldr: 本文提出导航信息嵌入（NIE），利用智能体搜索轨迹中的停止和路径信息，无需额外标注或合成数据即可适配密集检索器，显著提升目标基准上的检索性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Navigation-Informed Embeddings (NIE), which adapt dense retrievers using stop and path traces from agentic search workflows without extra labels or synthetic data, significantly boosting retrieval performance on target benchmarks.
